data.professional_title: CERTIFIED ADOBE WORKFRONT AND FUSION DEVELOPER
data.summary: Detail-oriented Adobe Workfront and Fusion Developer specializing in automation, system integration, and workflow optimization to improve efficiency and support business critical operations.

all_skills: Form Migration Automation: Automated custom form migration from sandbox to production
reducing deployment time by 70% for a Pharmaceutical client and eliminating manual configuration errors.
Project Template Migration: Built an Adobe Fusion-based automation to migrate project templates in Workfront
reducing onboarding and handover effort by 40% and cutting effort from days to hours.
CSV Driven Template Creation: Built a CSV-based automation to create project templates with group setup
saving 8-10 hours per template and significantly reducing initialization effort.
System Integrations: Designed and supported integrations between Workfront and external systems (Veeva Vault
ClickUp) for Life Sciences client to enable seamless cross platform data synchronization.
Scenario Optimization: Documented and optimized existing Fusion scenarios for a leading Telecommunications client
improving execution performance by approximately 30% and reducing failures and maintenance effort.
Advanced Workflow Automations: Developed and implemented multiple Fusion-based automations
including periodic custom field updates (reducing manual maintenance by 60%)
issue to project and program conversions
automated asset push to AEM upon status changes
and dynamic task status updates based on project custom form actions
enhancing workflow efficiency and data consistency.
Enterprise Instance Assessment: Led assessment of a large Workfront instance covering 130+ project templates
delivering recommendations that improved operational efficiency by 25% for a global Financial Services enterprise.
Enablement & Communication: Created and edited demo videos to showcase automation tools and delivered solutions
while acting as the team’s creative lead by designing executive-ready presentations and drafting companywide communications to drive adoption
QA Lead: Led end to end QA for Adobe Workfront
and AEM Assets in an Agile environment for Insurance Services client
delivering a stable and successful go-live.
Consulting & Multi-Project Delivery: Drove requirements and solution alignment in a stakeholder-facing Analyst role while managing parallel projects and contributing to RFP design

Automation & Tool Development
Form Migration Automation: Automated custom form migration from sandbox to production, reducing deployment time by 70% for a Pharmaceutical client and eliminating manual configuration errors.
Project Template Migration: Built an Adobe Fusion-based automation to migrate project templates in Workfront, reducing onboarding and handover effort by 40% and cutting effort from days to hours.
CSV Driven Template Creation: Built a CSV-based automation to create project templates with group setup, sharing, and parent-child task hierarchy, saving 8-10 hours per template and significantly reducing initialization effort.
System Integrations: Designed and supported integrations between Workfront and external systems (Veeva Vault, ClickUp) for Life Sciences client to enable seamless cross platform data synchronization.
Scenario Optimization: Documented and optimized existing Fusion scenarios for a leading Telecommunications client, improving execution performance by approximately 30% and reducing failures and maintenance effort.
Advanced Workflow Automations: Developed and implemented multiple Fusion-based automations, including periodic custom field updates (reducing manual maintenance by 60%), issue to project and program conversions, automated asset push to AEM upon status changes, and dynamic task status updates based on project custom form actions, enhancing workflow efficiency and data consistency.
Solution Delivery & Enablement
Enterprise Instance Assessment: Led assessment of a large Workfront instance covering 130+ project templates, 19 layouts, and 65 job roles, delivering recommendations that improved operational efficiency by 25% for a global Financial Services enterprise.
Demo, Enablement & Communication: Created and edited demo videos to showcase automation tools and delivered solutions, while acting as the team’s creative lead by designing executive-ready presentations and drafting companywide communications to drive adoption, alignment, and clarity.
QA Lead: Led end to end QA for Adobe Workfront, Adobe Fusion, and AEM Assets in an Agile environment for Insurance Services client, proactively coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholder expectations, driving structured defect triage discussions, and ensuring timely signoffs, delivering a stable and successful go-live.
Consulting & Multi-Project Delivery: Drove requirements and solution alignment in a stakeholder-facing Analyst role while managing parallel projects and contributing to RFP design, estimation, and documentation.
